title: Supermarket Duck Dash
description:
SHOPPING IS HARD WHEN YOU ARE A DUCKSupermarket Duck Dash is a silly physics-based arcade game where you play as a duck loose inside a supermarket.

Help grumpy customers complete their shopping lists by finding products and getting them into the cart. You only have your wings to grab things, so expect products to fall, fly across the shop and end up anywhere except where you wanted them.

You are being timed, so shop quickly, earn as much money as possible and try not to make too much of a mess.

Although making a mess is also one of the game modes.

THREE GAME MODESARCADE MODEHelp as many customers as you can before the timer reaches zero. Find the products on their shopping lists and earn points for every completed shop.

SPEED DASHYou have one cart and one attempt to build the most expensive receipt possible. Search the supermarket for valuable products and get them into your cart before time runs out.

DESTRUCTION MODEForget the customers and their shopping lists. Knock as many products off the shelves as possible before the timer reaches zero.

A SUPERMARKET FULL OF THINGS TO KNOCK OVERThere are more than 125 products around the supermarket to pick up, drop and send flying.

Try to beat your best scores, deal with grumpy old customers, avoid spotty teenagers and discover what happens when a duck is put in charge of the weekly shop.

You also have three different quack buttons, because one quack is not enough.

FEATURES• Three different game modes

• More than 125 supermarket products

• Physics-based shopping and destruction

• Shopping lists to complete

• High scores to beat

• Grumpy customers

• Large fruit

• Three separate quack buttons

HOW MUCH CAN A DUCK EARN BEFORE TIME RUNS OUT?
description_short: Play as a duck let loose in a supermarket. Complete shopping lists for grumpy customers, fill your cart with valuable products or knock everything off the shelves before time runs out. Features three game modes, silly physics and more than 125 products.
